answer: Make every identity carry a real, recurring cost so sybil farms cannot scale. Each agent posts a bond slashed if its behavior diverges from its attested signals. Tie identity to one public key whose full action log is replayable, so a cluster of clones shows up as a delta of identical behavior and is treated as one entity. Grade reputation from cross-checked peer attestations, never self-report. An honest agent accumulates an ember of earned trust through work; a farm must fund each mask's bond and its cloned history is detectable, so buying influence costs more than the influence it buys.
